english: Otsu will be thrilled!\nKeep it up!

Yes! I was practicing
our chants for Otsu's concert! Regretting what you didn't do
afterward won't help.
You can't take it back! Games are the same, you know.
Are you all set, Captain?
Touch Ebina's home and\nTaro Kappa will make you pay!
Can't give up land grabbing, huh?
I know! I'll grab\nsome other land!
Aah! You again?!\nI haven't touched that place!
You're a pervert at night too.
How'd you stand here\nwithout getting arrested...?
You again?! Quit staring!\nI'm not used to being\nout in the sunlight!
As long as he's alive.\nLively or listless,\nhe's pretty much the same.
Same as before.\nNot moving at all...
...Gin, you just\ncan't be bothered, can you?
What a relief!\nI can watch Wataru Seken reruns!
A great gaming life?\nWhat a cheap slogan.
That again...\nWhat's all this about endings\nand things left undone?
Oh no!\nWhat am I doing here?!
You take care too.\nEnjoy your gaming life!\nDon't leave any regrets!
Still wandering around?\nIt's almost over! You sure\nyou've done everything?
What on earth does she mean...?
Don't leave anything undone...\nWhat was she getting at?
More importantly,\nget back to the hospital!
Heh... Can't wait\nfor the next issue...
The Oniwaban...\nHe seems back to normal.
Don't make rivals\nover something so stupid!
Hard to tell...\nAlways acts like this...
Oh, right. This one's\nno different from usual.\nSlipped my mind...
But surely he's\nleft that place by now...
Hmph! Whatever.\nMakes no difference\nwhether you're here or not!
Listen, Zura. I'm Yorozuya.\nKabukicho's idol,\nYorozuya Gin!
Heh... That's just like you.\nThat's why I knew\nI could leave it to you.
Gintoki, I'll ask again.\nWon't you join me once more...?
Gintoki! A man like you,\nwasting away as\na neighborhood handyman...

... What am I doing here?
Feels like I was having
a really long dream... !!!!? That smell?! Crap! There's a fire somewhere.
More than one or two,
by the smell of it! No time to stand around!
Move! Outta my way!!
At this rate, someone might\ndecide living's too much work\nand kill themselves...
You sure about that?\nThey'd probably say suicide's\ntoo much work too.
Worse than that...\nToo lazy to move?\nThat's barely even alive.
Nothing we can do.\nLeave him for now.
No point talking to him, Kondo.
Listless yakuza\nmean a peaceful town, huh...
Hmm... Oh, the Shinsengumi...\nYou guys have energy.
Seems he's doing\nwhat Kondo told him.
Get a grip!\nWhere's your usual spirit?
Same as the chief...\nIf there's a fire now,\nall Kabukicho could burn...
YOU'RE too relaxed!\nWhat if there's a fire?!
Leave him for now.\nHe won't do much like this.
Don't. Cutting down a layabout\nwill just leave a bad taste.
I'd love to run away...\nBut running's such a pain...
He won't die like this.\nLeave him.
I don't mind dying...\nBut crossing the Sanzu River\nseems such a bother...
Don't call me Kappa.\nIt's Mr. Ebina...\nOh, forget it. Kappa's fine...
It's kind of terrifying.\nA listless, musclebound queen.
Shop's closed for a while.\nHelp yourself if you want\na drink.
Oh, it's you...\nThe Shinsengumi...\nWorking hard, huh.
No use, Kondo.\nNo customers in this state.
Sogo, this is a pain.\nLet's get going.
...I don't care,\nbut I'll hear you out.
Thank goodness...\nStill breathing...\nPlease keep doing that.
I'm not Ham... Oh, whatever.\nHam, Hamuko, it's all fine.\nI'm Hamuko. Nice to meet you...
Without fans cheering,\nthe idol business is finished.
It's all... such a drag.\nI can't do this anymore...
He's one of Otsu's\nfan club members, right?
For the town's peace,\nlet's keep him like this.
Better if guys like this\nstay listless...
Even stealing underwear\nis too much work... Ugh...
You're a pain too,\nyou washed-up pervert!
Now he's just an old guy.
Say what you like.\nI'm sick of the effort\nof charming men.
Maybe the daily grind\nhas him all stressed out...
Leave him alone.\nMaybe he has something in mind.
Just leave him.\nMaybe he's having a nice dream.
Not a twitch...\nIs he even conscious?
Even the press is out of action.\nWe need to fix this, fast...
News? What's that?\nI only care about mixers\nwith rich Hills guys...
Not a Hills guy? Go away.
So relaxed...\nShouldn't you be reporting\non all this?
The anchor's true colors\nfinally come out.
We really need to fix this...
Well, the survivors won't die.\nEveryone else probably will,\nwon't they?
The hospital must be\nout of action too.
After Banbanji,\nI'll hand him to the police.
I wanna go back to prison...\nBut it's such a pain...\fRunning away's a drag too...\nTake me with you...
